title: AI ML Project Manager
description:
AI/ML Project Manager

**Experience:** 8–12 years overall (3–5 years in AI/ML project management)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Project Manager to lead AI and machine learning initiatives from idea to production. You will work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI solutions that create real business impact.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage AI/ML projects end-to-end: requirement gathering, feasibility assessment, development, testing, deployment, and production support
* Coordinate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Developers, and business stakeholders
* Define project scope, timelines, milestones, resource plans, budgets, and delivery KPIs
* Track progress, manage risks and dependencies, and resolve implementation challenges
* Ensure a smooth transition of AI/ML solutions from PoC to production
* Manage stakeholder communication, project governance, and delivery reporting

Required Qualifications

* Proven track record of managing and delivering AI/ML projects from initiation through production deployment
* Hands-on exposure to AI/ML implementation, including model development coordination, validation, deployment, and monitoring
* Experience managing cross-functional technical teams in Agile environments
* Experience with cloud AI/ML platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Experience with project tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or MS Project

Technical Understanding

* ML fundamentals, model training, validation, and evaluation metrics
* Data pipelines, data quality, model deployment, and MLOps
* APIs, cloud infrastructure, production monitoring, and model performance
* Basic understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, and RAG (preferred)

Key Skills

* Project planning, execution, and delivery management
* Stakeholder management and communication
* Risk management and problem-solving
* Cross-functional team coordination

Nice to Have

* Exposure to Generative AI / LLM projects

title: Project Engineer
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Project Engineer - Data Centre ConstructionJLL Project and Development ServicesPosition OverviewThe Project Engineer will support the execution and delivery of the Adani Data Centre project in Dholera, working under JLL's Project and Development Services division. This role requires hands-on involvement in managing day-to-day construction activities, coordinating with multiple stakeholders, and ensuring project objectives are met in terms of quality, schedule, and budget for this critical mission-critical facility.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesConstruction Management & Coordination
  
Manage daily construction activities for the data centre project, ensuring work progresses according to approved schedules and specifications. Coordinate with multiple contractors and subcontractors including civil, structural, MEP, electrical, and specialty data centre systems contractors. Conduct daily site walks to monitor work quality, progress, safety compliance, and adherence to project standards. Facilitate coordination meetings with contractors to resolve interface issues and maintain workflow efficiency.
  
Technical Documentation & Submittals
  
Review contractor submittals including shop drawings, material data sheets, method statements, and equipment specifications for compliance with design intent and project requirements. Track submittal status and ensure timely review and approval cycles to prevent delays. Maintain comprehensive project documentation including RFIs, site instructions, daily reports, progress photographs, and as-built records. Prepare and distribute meeting minutes, site inspection reports, and progress updates to project stakeholders.
  
Schedule Monitoring & Progress Tracking
  
Monitor construction progress against the project baseline schedule and identify potential delays or critical path impacts. Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports detailing completed activities, upcoming milestones, and schedule variance analysis. Coordinate with contractors to develop recovery plans when schedule deviations occur. Update project schedules based on actual site conditions and communicate changes to the project management team.
  
Quality Control & Compliance
  
Conduct inspections of ongoing work to verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards specific to data centre construction. Coordinate with the QAQC team to ensure proper testing and commissioning procedures for critical systems including raised floor, cooling infrastructure, power distribution, and fire suppression systems. Verify that materials delivered to site match approved specifications and maintain material traceability records.
  
Budget Management Support
  
Track and monitor project costs by reviewing contractor invoices, payment applications, and change order proposals. Assist in preparing cost forecasts, budget variance reports, and expenditure tracking documents. Identify potential cost-saving opportunities and value engineering options without compromising project quality or functionality.
  
Data Centre-Specific Coordination
  
Coordinate installation and testing of mission-critical data centre infrastructure including UPS systems, generator sets, precision cooling units, electrical distribution equipment, and monitoring systems. Ensure proper coordination between raised floor installation, cable management systems, and equipment placement. Facilitate coordination between IT infrastructure consultants, equipment vendors, and installation contractors to ensure seamless integration of data centre systems.
  
Stakeholder Communication
  
Serve as primary on-site liaison between JLL project management, Adani stakeholders, design consultants, contractors, and local authorities. Communicate project status, issues, and requirements clearly and promptly to all relevant parties. Participate in client meetings and site walkthroughs, presenting project progress and addressing concerns professionally.
  
Regulatory & Statutory Compliance
  
Ensure all construction activities comply with local building codes, Gujarat state regulations, and statutory requirements applicable to the Dholera Special Investment Region. Coordinate with local authorities for inspections, approvals, and statutory clearances required during construction. Maintain updated knowledge of special requirements for data centre facilities including fire safety, electrical safety, and environmental compliance.
  
Site Safety Management
  
Support the project safety team in implementing and monitoring site safety protocols and procedures. Participate in safety inspections and toolbox talks to promote a safety-first culture on site. Ensure contractors maintain required safety equipment, signage, and emergency response procedures. Report safety incidents and near-misses promptly and participate in incident investigations.
  
Required QualificationsEducation & Experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline required. Minimum 4-6 years of experience in construction project management or site engineering roles. Prior experience with data centre, critical facility, or industrial construction projects highly preferred. Experience working on large-scale infrastructure projects in India required.
  
Technical Competencies
  
Strong understanding of construction methods, sequencing, and coordination for multi-disciplinary projects. Knowledge of data centre infrastructure components including power systems, cooling systems, raised floors, and cable management. Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, MEP, and electrical drawings. Familiarity with construction contracts, specifications, and standard industry practices.
  
Software Proficiency
  
Proficient in MS Project or Primavera P6 for schedule tracking and analysis. Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for reporting and documentation. Experience with project management software and document control systems. Knowledge of BIM coordination tools (Navisworks, BIM 360) is advantageous.
  
Professional Skills
  
Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities to manage multiple work fronts simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills with ability to make sound decisions under pressure. Effective communication skills in English and Hindi (knowledge of Gujarati is beneficial). Detail-oriented with strong documentation and record-keeping capabilities. Team player with ability to work collaboratively in a diverse, multi-cultural environment.
  
Regulatory Knowledge
  
Understanding of Indian building codes, NBC provisions, and local regulatory requirements. Familiarity with Gujarat state construction regulations and Dholera Special Investment Region guidelines. Knowledge of data centre standards including Uptime Institute Tier classifications, TIA-942, and relevant IS codes.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Project Manager-Transmission Line
description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

Job Purpose

Lead the complete PMC assignment for the transmission line, HVAC substations and HVDC terminal station packages, ensuring that the works are delivered safely, within the approved scope, schedule, budget, quality requirements and contractual framework.

Key Responsibilities

* Act as the principal point of contact between the Consultant, Client, EPC contractors, OEMs and other stakeholders.
* Establish the Project Execution Plan, organization structure, responsibility matrix, communication protocol and reporting arrangements.
* Lead mobilization and deployment of PMC resources across transmission line sections, substations and HVDC terminal stations.
* Review and monitor the contractor's baseline schedule, procurement plan, construction methodology, resource plan and commissioning programme.
* Coordinate transmission line, substation, HVDC, civil, electrical, mechanical, protection, SCADA, telecom, quality, HSE and contractual interfaces.
* Monitor overall progress against approved milestones, identify deviations and direct preparation of recovery or acceleration plans.
* Review critical technical submissions, constructability issues, interface matters and site constraints requiring management decisions.
* Ensure effective implementation of the approved quality plan, inspection and test plans and HSE management system.
* Lead periodic progress, technical, contractual, risk, quality and HSE review meetings.
* Review contractor claims, variations, extension-of-time submissions and change requests with the Contracts Manager and Planning Engineer.
* Monitor project risks and maintain an updated risk register, mitigation plan and management action log.
* Ensure timely resolution of ROW, access, crossing, outage, interface, land, statutory and stakeholder constraints.
* Review recommendations for certification of contractor invoices, milestone payments and completion status.
* Lead construction-completion, pre-commissioning, energization-readiness and handover reviews.
* Ensure timely close-out of punch points, NCRs, technical queries, as-built drawings, test records and completion dossiers.
* Provide timely advice to the Client on technical, schedule, quality, HSE, contractual and commercial matters.
* Manage team performance, workload allocation, succession planning and replacement of personnel, where required.
* Ensure project decisions, instructions and approvals are properly recorded and communicated.

Key Deliverables

* Project Execution Plan.
* Organization and mobilization plan.
* Monthly and weekly progress reports.
* Executive progress dashboard.
* Risk and opportunity register.
* Management action and decision log.
* Recovery and acceleration recommendations.
* Completion, energization-readiness and project close-out reports.

 **Qualifications**

Minimum Qualification and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Civil or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in EHV transmission line and substation projects.
* Demonstrated experience in leading at least one major 400 kV/765 kV transmission or substation project.
* Experience in HVDC, GIS, large power transformers, reactors, control and protection systems will be preferred.
* Working knowledge of project controls, contracts, quality management, HSE, procurement, construction and commissioning.
* Proficiency in project reporting, stakeholder management and multidisciplinary coordination.

  
**Additional Information**

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Assistant Project Lead - MEPFJLL Project & Development Services
  
Position OverviewSupport the Project Lead in delivering mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection (MEPF) projects across new construction, fit-outs, and building upgrades. Coordinate engineering consultants, contractors, and stakeholders while ensuring technical compliance, budget adherence, and schedule performance.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesProject Coordination Assist in managing MEPF projects including base building systems, tenant fit-outs, equipment replacements, and infrastructure upgrades. Monitor installation progress, track critical milestones, and escalate technical issues requiring resolution.
  
Technical Management Review MEPF design submissions, shop drawings, and O&M documentation for compliance with specifications and standards. Coordinate with engineering consultants on system design, load calculations, and equipment selections.
  
Stakeholder Management Coordinate with clients, MEP consultants, contractors, local authorities, and facility management teams. Facilitate technical meetings, distribute RFIs and submittals, and ensure alignment on system requirements and performance criteria.
  
Financial Management Assist in budget preparation, cost tracking, and financial reporting for MEPF scope. Review contractor payment applications, evaluate variation requests for technical merit, and maintain accurate project cost records.
  
Quality & Compliance Monitor MEPF installation quality through site inspections and testing witnessing. Ensure compliance with building codes, engineering standards, energy regulations, and health and safety requirements. Support commissioning activities and defect rectification processes.
  
  
**QualificationsRequired:**  
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Building Services Engineering
  
3-5 years' experience in MEPF project delivery or building services coordination
  
Understanding of HVAC, electrical distribution, plumbing, and fire protection systems
  
Knowledge of relevant codes and standards (NEC, IBC, ASHRAE, NFPA, or local equivalents)
  
Proficiency in reading MEP drawings and technical specifications
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  
  
**Preferred:**  
Professional engineering registration or working toward licensure
  
Experience with BIM coordination and clash detection
  
Familiarity with energy efficiency and sustainability standards (LEED, ASHRAE 90.1)
  
Knowledge of building automation and smart building technologies

title: Project Manager – Wellness Resorts & Partnerships
company: Biz Accounting and Support Pvt Ltd
description:
**Project Manager – Wellness Resorts \& Partnerships**

We are looking for a Project Manager to work closely with the senior leadership team, and external partners on wellness resort growth, new venture evaluation, and strategic partnerships.

This role is not limited to tracking tasks. The person will be expected to keep leadership informed, move decisions forward, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and ensure that agreed actions are completed on time.

**Role Purpose**

The Project Manager will act as the central coordination point for a portfolio of wellness resort and partnership initiatives. This includes supporting existing resort operations, assessing potential wellness retreat opportunities in India and overseas, engaging hospitality and technology partners, and maintaining an active network of wellness experts.

The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly with senior executives, business owners, consultants, and potential partners. They should be structured, commercially aware, and able to handle multiple workstreams without losing follow\-through.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary coordination link between the senior leadership team, internal teams, and external stakeholders.
* Prepare regular updates for the leadership team on priorities, decisions required, progress against plans, risks, and next actions.
* Manage project plans, timelines, meeting cadence, action trackers, and stakeholder communications across multiple initiatives.
* Support the growth and improvement of existing wellness resort businesses.
* Evaluate potential wellness retreat, resort, land, property, and business acquisition opportunities in India and, where relevant, international markets.
* Conduct preliminary research on potential locations, including market demand, accessibility, local competition, tourism trends, regulatory considerations, operating feasibility, and partner availability.
* Coordinate discussions with property owners, sellers, operators, hospitality companies, consultants, and potential collaborators.
* Support commercial discussions and negotiations with sellers, business owners, hospitality partners, and technology providers.
* Track leadership assignments and ensure that owners, deadlines, dependencies, and outcomes are clearly documented.
* Build and maintain relationships with wellness experts in India and the United States, including clinicians, therapists, retreat designers, nutrition specialists, fitness professionals, and wellness program advisors.
* Identify technology companies that can support wellness operations, guest experience, bookings, CRM, diagnostics, preventive health, digital engagement, or operational reporting.
* Coordinate partnership discussions and help prepare proposals, commercial summaries, meeting notes, and draft agreements.
* Escalate delays, decision gaps, and project risks early, with practical options for resolution.

**Key Deliverables**

**Weekly leadership status report**

Concise update covering project status, key achievements, upcoming milestones, decisions required, risks, and action owners

**Project plans**

Detailed plans for each initiative, including scope, milestones, timelines, dependencies, responsibilities, and risk mitigation actions

**Opportunity assessment reports**

Location and business evaluation reports for prospective resorts, retreats, properties, or partnerships

**Stakeholder communication log**

Record of meetings, discussions, commitments, follow\-up actions, and relationship status with partners and experts

**Partnership proposals**

Structured proposals for hospitality, wellness, and technology partners, including commercial rationale and next steps

**Expert network database**

Curated list of wellness experts, their areas of expertise, contact details, past interactions, and potential contribution to current projects

**Leadership action tracker**

Central tracker for Chairman and senior\-management assignments, with ownership, deadlines, progress, and closure status

**Required Experience and Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in project management, business development, strategy, hospitality, wellness, real estate, consulting, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with senior executives and manage confidential or high\-priority assignments.
* Experience coordinating external stakeholders, including business owners, consultants, vendors, operators, and strategic partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear executive updates and meeting summaries.
* Good commercial judgment and confidence in supporting negotiations and partnership discussions.
* Ability to assess business opportunities using structured criteria rather than relying only on informal discussions.
* Strong follow\-through, attention to detail, and discipline in managing action items.
* Ability to manage several active initiatives at the same time while maintaining clear priorities.
* Proficiency with project\-management and productivity tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, CRM platforms, Notion, Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with the Indian wellness, hospitality, tourism, healthcare, preventive health, or retreat market will be an advantage.
* International exposure or experience working with stakeholders in the United States, Middle East, Europe, or Southeast Asia would be useful.

**Preferred Profile**

The ideal candidate will be practical, organized, and commercially minded. They should be able to move comfortably between a executive\-level briefing, a discussion with a resort operator, a call with a wellness expert, and follow\-up with a technology vendor.

They must know how to turn discussions into clear next steps. For example, after an initial conversation with a resort owner, the Project Manager should document the opportunity, identify missing information, arrange due diligence inputs, track commercial assumptions, and prepare a short decision note for leadership.

This role will suit someone who enjoys building order around complex, evolving initiatives and is willing to take ownership of follow\-up rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹75,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Gandhinagar, Gujarat (Gandhinagar): Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Have you worked directly with Senior Executives, Founders, CEOs or C\-Level Leadership on high\-priority projects/assignments? If yes, for how many years?
* Have you independently managed multiple projects simultaneously? Please explain where and how.
* Do you have experience coordinating with external stakeholders (Consultants, Vendors or Operators)?
* Do you have experience preparing executive\-level reports, presentations, project updates or decision summaries? Please share more information.
* Which project\-management/productivity tools have you used? Please name all you've used.

Experience:

* Project management: 5 years (Required)
* Hotel management: 5 years (Preferred)

Language:

* English (Required)

Shift availability:

* Night Shift (Preferred)
* Overnight Shift (Preferred)
* Day Shift (Preferred)

title: SAP Project Manager
description:
**Senior SAP Project Manager**

**Experience:** 10\+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Gandhinagar, Gujarat

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **Senior SAP Project Manager** with **10\+ years of experience** in SAP project management, implementation, transformation, and global delivery.

The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of managing **SAP implementations, upgrades, migrations, rollouts, and transformation programs** across multiple countries and regions, with experience working across **APAC, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas**.

The candidate should be comfortable managing cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams, working with international clients, and engaging with senior business and technology stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and manage **end\-to\-end SAP projects**, including implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, integration, and transformation initiatives.
* Manage SAP projects across multiple countries, business units, and geographical regions.
* Develop and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, resources, and budgets.
* Lead geographically distributed teams across **India, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Spain, Italy, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, the United States, and Canada**, based on project requirements.
* Coordinate SAP functional and technical teams across different workstreams.
* Manage project scope, requirements, dependencies, risks, issues, change requests, and escalations.
* Establish project governance, reporting structures, steering committee meetings, and project review mechanisms.
* Act as a key point of contact for clients and senior stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Manage relationships with SAP implementation partners, system integrators, vendors, and third\-party providers.
* Monitor project performance against agreed **scope, schedule, budget, quality, and business objectives**.
* Oversee testing, data migration, cutover, go\-live, stabilization, and transition activities.
* Ensure effective communication and collaboration across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, risk registers, and executive\-level updates.
* Identify and resolve delivery challenges proactively and escalate critical issues when required.
* Ensure adherence to project management methodologies, governance standards, and quality processes.
* Support continuous improvement and identify opportunities to optimize project delivery.
* Participate in client meetings, solution discussions, project estimations, proposals, and pre\-sales activities when required.

Global / International Experience

The candidate should have experience managing SAP projects across multiple international markets, with exposure to one or more of the following:

Asia\-Pacific (APAC)

**India, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam, and South Korea.**

Europe

**United Kingdom, Germany, France, Netherlands, Belgium, Switzerland, Spain, Italy, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Ireland, and Poland.**

Middle East

**United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, and Bahrain.**

Africa

**South Africa, Egypt, Kenya, Nigeria, and Morocco.**

Americas

**United States, Canada, Mexico, and Brazil.**

**International experience across multiple countries and regions is highly preferred, particularly experience managing multi\-country SAP implementations and global rollout programs.**

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* **10\+ years of overall IT experience**, with significant experience in SAP Project Management.
* Proven experience managing **end\-to\-end SAP implementations, rollouts, upgrades, migrations, or transformation projects**.
* Experience managing projects involving multiple countries, teams, and stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of SAP project lifecycle, implementation methodologies, governance, and delivery processes.
* Experience with **SAP S/4HANA** is highly preferred.
* Good understanding of SAP functional and technical landscapes, integrations, data migration, testing, cutover, and deployment.
* Experience managing project scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Experience working with geographically distributed and multicultural teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and client\-facing experience.
* Experience managing SAP partners, system integrators, vendors, and third\-party providers.
* Ability to communicate effectively with business leaders, technology teams, and senior management.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, negotiation, and decision\-making skills.

Preferred Certifications

* **PMP (Project Management Professional)**
* **PRINCE2**
* SAP Project Management / SAP S/4HANA certification
* Agile / Scrum certification is an advantage.

Key Competencies

* SAP Project Management
* SAP S/4HANA Transformation
* Global SAP Implementations
* Multi\-Country SAP Rollouts
* APAC \& EMEA Delivery
* Europe \& Middle East Delivery
* Global Stakeholder Management
* Project Governance
* Budget \& Resource Management
* Risk \& Issue Management
* Vendor \& Partner Management
* Change Management
* Global Team Leadership
* Client Relationship Management
* Executive Communication
* Cross\-Cultural Team Management
* International Project Delivery

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be a **strong SAP Project Management professional with 10\+ years of experience** and demonstrated success in delivering SAP projects across **India, APAC, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and/or the Americas**.

They should be capable of managing **multiple workstreams, cross\-functional teams, international stakeholders, clients, vendors, and SAP partners**, while ensuring projects are delivered within agreed timelines, budgets, quality standards, and business objectives.

Pay: ₹2,500,000\.00 \- ₹3,000,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
